usage: train_backward_level1.py [-h] [--stage {train,evaluate,benchmark}]
                                [--config CONFIG] [--output OUTPUT]
                                [--observer-diagnostics-output OBSERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_OUTPUT]
                                [--frames FRAMES | --updates UPDATES]
                                [--resume RESUME] [--trials TRIALS] [--final]
                                [--record] [--skip-initial-evaluation]
                                [--reset-frame RESET_FRAME]
                                [--all-suffix-starts]
                                [--curriculum-adaptation]
                                [--normalization-adaptation]
                                [--timing-adaptation] [--reward-adaptation]
                                [--scoped-kind18-reward-resume]
                                [--score-reward-adaptation]
                                [--adaptation-validation-only]
                                [--evaluation-preparation-only]
                                [--evaluation-action-omission-plan EVALUATION_ACTION_OMISSION_PLAN]
                                [--evaluation-action-omission-condition {A,B,C}]
                                [--allow-evaluation-provenance-difference]
                                [--allow-precommitted-actor-difference]
                                [--reset-resumed-workers]
                                [--bc-initialized-extension]
                                [--no-stall-limit]
                                [--evaluation-seed EVALUATION_SEED]
                                [--evaluation-id EVALUATION_ID]
                                [--no-reset-jitter]
                                [--evaluation-horizon-frames EVALUATION_HORIZON_FRAMES]
                                [--evaluation-mode {sampled,greedy}]
                                [--serial-evaluation]
                                [--save-evaluation-policy-inputs]
                                [--compact-evaluation-capture]
                                [--reference-policy-input-fingerprints REFERENCE_POLICY_INPUT_FINGERPRINTS]
                                [--evaluation-artifact-root EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT]
                                [--evaluation-artifact-budget-mib EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_BUDGET_MIB]
                                [--evaluation-artifact-remaining-mib EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_REMAINING_MIB]
                                [--evaluation-minimum-free-mib EVALUATION_MINIMUM_FREE_MIB]
                                [--evaluation-temp-overhead-mib EVALUATION_TEMP_OVERHEAD_MIB]
                                [--delayed-takeover-noop-prefix-frames {1,2,4,8,16}]
                                [--stop-on-frontier-mastery]

Single-policy backward PPO, with separately flagged human BC+PPO extensions.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stage {train,evaluate,benchmark}
  --config CONFIG
  --output OUTPUT
  --observer-diagnostics-output OBSERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_OUTPUT
                        Runtime-only directory for worker observer failure
                        artifacts
  --frames FRAMES       Additional fresh emulator frames in this bounded block
                        (default 500000 when no budget is supplied)
  --updates UPDATES     Additional outer PPO collection/update cycles; each
                        cycle collects one rollout and performs its configured
                        optimization passes
  --resume RESUME
  --trials TRIALS
  --final
  --record
  --skip-initial-evaluation
  --reset-frame RESET_FRAME
                        Evaluation-only suffix start; never counted as full-
                        start performance
  --all-suffix-starts   Evaluate greedy once at EVERY valid native-frame start
                        in suffix jitter range; sampled count still --trials
  --curriculum-adaptation
                        Explicitly fork into a NEW output with changed
                        coverage anchors only
  --normalization-adaptation
                        Explicit NEW-output compatible-weight branch
                        normalization fork; reset optimizer and rewarm critic
  --timing-adaptation   Explicit NEW-output held-native-frame timing
                        comparison; preserve weights and optimizer
  --reward-adaptation   Explicit new-output baseline -> tested potential-
                        reward experiment
  --scoped-kind18-reward-resume
                        Permit only ABI2 observer activation and the 0/.25
                        scoped kind18 defeat coefficient; learning state is
                        preserved
  --score-reward-adaptation
                        Activate the tested displayed-score reward while
                        preserving resumed worker, curriculum, RNG, and actor
                        state
  --adaptation-validation-only
                        Restore and validate an explicit adaptation plan, then
                        exit before creating workers or training
  --evaluation-preparation-only
                        Validate a fixed suffix evaluation through
                        checkpoint/config preparation, then exit before
                        emulator or worker creation
  --evaluation-action-omission-plan EVALUATION_ACTION_OMISSION_PLAN
                        Evaluation only: one precommitted normal-game one-
                        frame action omission plan
  --evaluation-action-omission-condition {A,B,C}
                        Condition identifier within --evaluation-action-
                        omission-plan
  --allow-evaluation-provenance-difference
                        Evaluation only: permit a different checkpoint
                        training-run label when its model-config identity and
                        full runtime contract match
  --allow-precommitted-actor-difference
                        Evaluation only: apply the saved
                        intervention/reference mask to a trained endpoint
                        while preserving the precommit and runtime contract
  --reset-resumed-workers
                        Discard saved live worker episodes and reset using
                        configured roles; preserve model, optimizer, RNG, and
                        curriculum
  --bc-initialized-extension
                        Explicitly labelled BC initialization/auxiliary
                        extension; never primary PPO-only
  --no-stall-limit      Evaluation only: keep the full episode horizon without
                        the development stall cutoff
  --evaluation-seed EVALUATION_SEED
                        Evaluation-only common random seed base, independent
                        of checkpoint training counter
  --evaluation-id EVALUATION_ID
                        Evaluation-only safe identifier for output naming when
                        no training frame counter is recorded
  --no-reset-jitter     Evaluation only: use exactly --reset-frame with no
                        suffix jitter
  --evaluation-horizon-frames EVALUATION_HORIZON_FRAMES
                        Evaluation only: fixed native-frame episode horizon
  --evaluation-mode {sampled,greedy}
                        Evaluation only: run exactly one policy mode
  --serial-evaluation   Evaluation only: use one CPU environment worker
  --save-evaluation-policy-inputs
                        Save the encoded per-decision observation windows
                        supplied to the evaluator policy
  --compact-evaluation-capture
                        Stream compact action/RAM/reward traces and per-field
                        policy-input fingerprints
  --reference-policy-input-fingerprints REFERENCE_POLICY_INPUT_FINGERPRINTS
                        Verified offline fingerprint manifest for the saved
                        reference policy inputs
  --evaluation-artifact-root EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT
                        Shared new-artifact root used by compact capture
                        budget checks
  --evaluation-artifact-budget-mib EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_BUDGET_MIB
                        Maximum new artifact budget for compact evaluation
                        (MiB)
  --evaluation-artifact-remaining-mib EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_REMAINING_MIB
                        Remaining portion of the shared artifact cap available
                        to this serial episode
  --evaluation-minimum-free-mib EVALUATION_MINIMUM_FREE_MIB
                        Minimum disk free-space reserve enforced during
                        compact evaluation (MiB)
  --evaluation-temp-overhead-mib EVALUATION_TEMP_OVERHEAD_MIB
                        Measured temporary-file allowance included in compact
                        evaluation preflight (MiB)
  --delayed-takeover-noop-prefix-frames {1,2,4,8,16}
                        Isolated exact-reset evaluation: advance 1, 2, 4, 8,
                        or 16 normal-game NOOP frames before greedy takeover
  --stop-on-frontier-mastery
                        Finish and checkpoint the current PPO update, then
                        stop after the first earlier-frontier mastery
                        transition
